cartridges.title: A uPD7725 program dump of 8192 bytes
cartridges.source: external/images/, by its id, copied from the image library's 5 Tools & Service Test Carts/CPU/ folder, the 8192-byte file with this digest
cartridges.layout: 2048 program words of three bytes, then 1024 table words of two, each word stored low byte first. Reversing the bytes of every word gives the image named by canonicalSha256, the layout snes-dsp-python keys its manifest on, high byte first
cartridges.exercises: The program and table of a uPD7725, read rather than run: conformance/testroms.py walks every path from reset and from the interrupt vector and holds how deep its calls nest against the 4 stack levels the part has. Running it needs a host feeding it commands with known answers, which is snes-dsp-python's work
